title: Wild Walk clear reader detects and restores native active state

verification.actor: Requested Wild Rattata19, its own native spawn identity and landing point, current handle and engine object.
verification.trigger: Observe one natural four-frame Walk and actual Local clear; while paused change only the current active byte from0 to1, read through the same reader, then restore.
verification.observable: The unchanged clear checker rejects the changed byte. Exact state, registers and clocks are restored. The reader and private session close.

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav, checked teleport and native Rattata request. Match its finalized identity and own spawn point, wait idle. No profile, timer or movement intent edits.
After a real Walk clear, change only the current active byte while the guest is paused, restore in finally, and check exact readback. Failed restore stops the private core.

limits: Reader calibration only; this session grants no natural movement, spawning, terrain or soak credit.

control.fault: Current cleared Wild active byte reads1 instead of0.
control.expectedFailure: The unchanged checker rejects the bad read and accepts exact restoration before guest execution resumes.

events.value: Bind only the requested Rattata at its own spawn point.
Complete natural Walk, real clear, same-reader fault, exact restoration and close.

stop.condition: One real Walk clear and one restored reader fault, then clean private session close.

invariants: Every active actor has an attached presentation
